formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Equation Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C2.1 and C2.2.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can describe variables and test equivalence.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can describe variables and test equivalence.
header.character_watermark: Eddy in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Describe what the variable T stands for in T = today's temperature.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. A description slot.

image_placeholders.description: A description slot in B&W, ~6in x 1in. 'T stands for: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_VAR: keywords (variable) name what the slot asks for.

prompts.answer_key: T stands for the temperature value (varies).

prompts.visual_layout: Upper-middle. A single test row with EQ/NOT bubbles.

image_placeholders.description: A test row in B&W, ~6in x 1in. '50+25 vs 100-25'. With EQ/NOT bubbles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_ADD: keywords (test) name the row.

prompts.visual_layout: Middle of page. A single test row with EQ/NOT bubbles.

image_placeholders.description: A test row in B&W, ~6in x 1in. '24÷4 vs 30÷5'. With EQ/NOT bubbles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_DIV: keywords (test) name the row.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, or TRY AGAIN.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three faces in a row labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, and TRY AGAIN.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row in B&W. Smile labelled GOT IT, neutral labelled ALMOST, frown labelled TRY AGAIN.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q4_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: variable + add/sub + mult/div = ready for Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Engineer Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Eddy holding a Junior Equation Engineer certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Equation Engineer? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Three star-rating ovals.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am an Engineer!'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row YES/NO table in B&W. Rows: 'I described variables', 'I tested add/sub equivalence', 'I tested mult/div equivalence', 'I found many ways for big numbers', 'I made a balance puzzle'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

options: I found many ways for big numbers

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE engineer task?

image_placeholders.description: Five icons in B&W: variable, add/sub equivalence, mult/div equivalence, many-ways hunt, balance puzzle. Each ~1in x 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the five options.

prompts.visual_layout: Lower-middle. Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Variables', 'Mult/div equivalence', 'Many ways'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Bigger numbers', 'Two variables', 'Real-world equations'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.
